q1.sampleAnswer: My name’s Wang Fang. I’m fourteen years old. I live in Chengdu, in the south-west of China. I live with my mum, my dad and my little brother. I use my mobile phone every day after school, mostly to send messages to my friends, but my parents don’t let me use it late at night. My favourite time of day is the morning, because I feel fresh and I can have a big breakfast. In the future I’d like to work as a vet, because I love animals. I like listening to rock music because it gives me lots of energy. Yes, I enjoy shopping, especially for clothes and books with my friends. In the future I’d like to study medicine, because I want to help people. On TV I like watching cooking programmes, because I can learn new recipes. I like reading comics, because they’re funny and easy to read.

q1.explanationZh: 好的回答不只回答“是/不是”或一个词，而是给出具体信息并说明理由（because…），用一般现在时谈习惯，用 I’d like to… 谈将来的愿望，每个问题说 1–3 句。

q2.sampleAnswer: In this photo I can see a teenage boy at home. I think he’s in his bedroom or a study room. He’s sitting at a desk and he’s holding a mobile phone in both hands. He’s smiling, so maybe he’s reading a funny message or watching a video. He has long dark hair and he’s wearing a light shirt. On the desk there’s an open laptop and some papers, so perhaps he was doing his homework before. Behind him there are some shelves with books and boxes, and there’s a lamp. On the left there’s a big plant, and on the right there’s a window, so the room looks bright. I think he’s having a short break and chatting with his friends.

q2.explanationZh: 好的回答按顺序描述照片：人物（是谁、穿什么、在做什么）、地点、其他细节；用现在进行时，遇到不确定的地方用 I think / maybe / perhaps… 猜测，持续说满约一分钟。

q3.sampleAnswer: Yes, I agree. Playing the guitar is fun, and he can practise as long as he wants. I’m not sure about washing the car. It’s useful for his parents, but it isn’t very exciting. You’re right – if he phones a friend, he isn’t really doing something by himself. But it’s nice if he feels lonely. I think playing chess is more interesting than watching sport on TV, because he has to think and plan. Watching TV is easy, but he doesn’t do anything. Reading a magazine is relaxing, but maybe he’ll finish it quickly and then feel bored. In my opinion, playing the guitar is the most interesting, because he can learn something new and enjoy music at the same time. OK, let’s choose the guitar.

q3.explanationZh: 好的回答能回应搭档的每一个观点（同意/不同意并说明理由），把每项活动和“一个人在家、要有趣”这一要求联系起来，用 I think / In my opinion / What about…? / Let’s… 推动讨论，最后与搭档一起选出最有趣的活动。

q4.sampleAnswer: When I’m by myself, I enjoy drawing, because it helps me relax and I can be creative. My friends and I like playing basketball together after school, because it’s exciting and we can talk and laugh. I usually feel calm when I’m by myself, but if I’m alone for too long, I feel a bit bored. I prefer doing schoolwork with my classmates, because we can help each other with difficult questions. But for tests I study by myself, because it’s quieter. I prefer team sports, like football, because it’s more fun to win together, and I can make new friends.

q4.explanationZh: 好的回答对每个问题都表明观点并给出理由或例子，比较“一个人做”和“和别人一起做”的好处，用 I prefer… because… / I usually… / If…, … 等结构，还可以从正反两方面谈。
